Name: Canyon Wingsuit 3D
Author: slyon
Description: 3rd-Person Procedural 3D Canyon Wingsuit Game for Stream Deck +. Steer with the rightmost dial, control pitch/lift with the leftmost dial, avoid stalling your chute or splattering into canyon carnage!

Actions.Name: Canyon 3D Viewport Tile (Key)
Actions.Tooltip: Place on all 8 LCD keys (4x2 grid) to form the panoramic 3rd-person 3D canyon display. Press any key to reset after a crash or chute landing.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Left Dial: Pitch Up/Down | Right Dial: Steer Left/Right

Actions.Name: Canyon Flight Dial & HUD
Actions.Tooltip: Place on the Stream Deck + dials or keys! Leftmost dial controls Pitch (Climb/Slow/Chute vs Dive/Speed/Carnage). Rightmost dial steers Left/Right.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Left Dial: Pitch Up/Down | Right Dial: Steer Left/Right
